title: AttachmentCompact
description: An *attachment* object represents any file attached to a task in Asana, whether it's an uploaded file or one associated via a third-party service such as Dropbox or Google Drive.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

resource_subtype.description: The service hosting the attachment. Valid values are `asana`, `dropbox`, `gdrive`, `onedrive`, `box`, `vimeo`, and `external`.
